name: Kinou
source:
One of Asterisk's sisters, and [url=https://vndb.org/c31034]Kyou[/url]'s twin sister, who looked after [url=https://vndb.org/c32069]Asterisk[/url].

They taught [url=https://vndb.org/c32069]Asterisk[/url] everything about fighting monsters and living life to the fullest, as well as having encouraged him to travel to the mainland.

[spoiler]A dragon, and member of the Witches of the Round Table. During the Arthur Tragedy, Asterisk's parents entrusted [url=https://vndb.org/c32069]Asterisk[/url] to the twins. [/spoiler]
